channel.title: Ethiopia - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Ethiopia, every source cited.

item.title: Jinhua trade with Africa reaches 161.41 billion yuan
item.description: Chinese city's exports to Africa, led by new energy products, grew 29.6% in nine months.

item.title: FAO urges Ethiopia to shift from aid to early action
item.description: The UN agency wants Ethiopia to invest in forecasts and warnings to protect livelihoods before climate disasters strike.

item.title: Renewed conflict threatens ethiopia's economic growth
item.description: The IMF forecasts 9.2% growth for 2025-26, but fighting could deter investment and raise living costs.

item.title: TPLF loses support after Tigray offensive falters
item.description: The Tigray People's Liberation Front has retreated to hills after its latest offensive against federal forces was repelled.
